decision_es: Esperar precio y datos de C1.ai; sin entrada aprobada. Central condicional151,34 USD vs cierre197,94; adverso91,00 y favorable246,02. Reconstrucción independiente, no réplica exacta de A058.
decision_en: Wait for price and C1.ai terms; no approved entry. Conditional central $151.34 versus $197.94 close; adverse $91.00, favorable $246.02. Independent reconstruction, not exact A058 replication.
pros_es: Ventas TTM +13,35% y EBIT +105,88%; la mejora sigue siendo fuerte tras contrastar reestructuración (+58,57%).
Retención bruta cercana al 97% y backlog a doce meses +14,2% respaldan recurrencia; no son retención neta.
FCF menos SBC TTM sube de 779 a 1.198 M$, con fuentes oficiales y puente comparable.
cons_es: 197,94 USD supera el central de 151,34; el favorable depende de más crecimiento, margen y menor WACC.
SBC TTM de 1.646 M$ consume gran parte del FCF publicado de 2.844 M$; recompras H1 de 2.924 M$ superan la caja libre de 1.076 M$.
C1.ai sigue sin precio y contribución suficientes para certificar el combinado; nueva deuda de 2.500 M$ no crea caja gratis.
Reorganizaciones repetidas y margen FY28 del 17%+ incluyendo SBC todavía no equivalen a GAAP.
pros_en: TTM revenue grew 13.35% and EBIT 105.88%; growth remains strong after a restructuring cross-check (+58.57%).
Approximately 97% gross retention and 14.2% current backlog growth support recurrence; neither equals net retention.
TTM FCF less SBC rose from $779m to $1,198m, reconciled to primary statements.
cons_en: $197.94 exceeds the $151.34 central case; the favorable case needs stronger growth and margins and lower WACC.
TTM SBC of $1,646m consumes much of reported $2,844m FCF; H1 buybacks of $2,924m exceed FCF of $1,076m.
C1.ai terms and contribution remain insufficient for combined valuation; $2,500m of new debt is not free cash.
Repeated reorganizations and FY28 adjusted margin of 17%+ including SBC still do not equal GAAP.
publication_note: Do not mark fully certified combined valuation or auto-enable entry; preserve A058, A137 and Stage3.5 guard. Source files private; only publish report, calculations and URL registry.
